state.title: Voice Studio — DaveAI.tech
state.bodyText:
VOICE STUDIO — STAGING
Voice Studio

Edge TTS synthesis server running on daveai.tech infrastructure. Real-time voice synthesis, multi-language support, and AI agent voice integration. Accessible via API or integrated into the DaveAI agent workflow.

Real-time TTS

Low-latency text-to-speech synthesis via Edge TTS engine. Multiple voices, styles, and speeds.

Multi-language

Supports 100+ languages and dialects. British and American English, Spanish, German, French, and more.

Agent Voice

Assign unique voices to each AI agent — Supervisor, Coder, QA, Asset. DaveAI reads responses aloud.

REST API

Clean API for programmatic synthesis. POST JSON, receive audio. Integrated into the Brain API.

API ENDPOINTS
POST /synthesize — Text-to-speech
GET /voices — Available voices
GET /health — Service status
POST /api/edge-tts — Via DaveAI proxy
Back to DaveAI.tech
